input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full: 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and transfer by change of control to Customer's consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bars assignment to a Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control. Section 13.3 aligns licence transfers with permitted Section 24 assignments, and no other provision (including the insolvency termination right in 9.2, which carves out lawful reorganizations) creates a change-of-control exit or re-pricing right against us. No redline needed.
